sections.title: Ragnarok · extended map
items: The exploration map has many biomes and special caves. Ascended main boss is Nunatak, replacing Evolved's battle Dragon + Manticore; Four named mini-bosses are located in three cave battle groups.
Ragnarok is large, has many biomes, has Griffin, Wyvern and its own dungeon.

sections.title: Terrain & biome
items: The Highlands, Viking Bay and the coast are good areas to explore when starting out; Check for predators, water, and escape routes before placing a base.
Biomes include mountains, forests, swamps, snow/ice, desert, and ocean. Cold trips need warm gear; hot/lava areas need water, heat protection, and a retreat route.
Wyvern south and ice area are not in the same line. Strong is now in Wyvern Cave in the south, different from Evolved's old Strong location.

sections.title: Resources & production
items: Suggestion: set up metal/crystal/obsidian routes in mountainous areas; Oil and silica pearls need to be planned according to coastal/cold zones. Conduct a survey before locating the industrial park.
Prioritize transportation and exploitation tame ( Argentavis, Ankylosaurus, Doedicurus ), smelting/smithy area and warehouse by material group. Don't build over the node area that needs to be farmed.

sections.title: Dino featured & DLC
items: There are Griffin, Wyvern, Dire Polar Bear and many species from other biomes. Open Dino to see taming, food, and stats.
DLC creatures are marked separately. There are Cerberax, Gargantar and Cryolophosaurus.

sections.title: Artifact & line
items: 10 artifact on 6 routes: Jungle Dungeon, Carnivorous Caverns, Frozen Dungeon, Life's Labyrinth, Wyvern Cave and Devourer sea route.
Hunter via Jungle; Pack via Frozen; Cunning / Immune via Carnivorous; Clever /Devious/ Massive / Skylord via Labyrinth; Strong side Wyvern; Devourer is a diving route.
Lava Elemental is optional loot; No winning required to get Hunter. Read the cave profile, checklist and GPS separately before the trip.

sections.title: Boss & conquer destination
items: Nunatak has Gamma / Beta / Alpha, needs all 10 artifacts and the correct level tribute. Read about flight/landing mechanics, minions, cold items, formations and Tekgram in the Boss section.
Iceworm Queen in Frozen Dungeon; Lava Elemental in Jungle; Spirit Dire Bear + Spirit Direwolf is the Life's Labyrinth battle group. Do not attach Gamma / Beta / Alpha to these mini-bosses.
Ragnarok does not use the Tek Cave / Overseer route of The Island. Select the target level to win Nunatak and the set Tek you want to open to calculate the next trip.

sections.title: Base suggestion · Ragnarok
items: Start where water, basic building materials, escape routes, and a safe farming route are available. Keep a small store, bed, smithy, and taming area away from predator paths.
Long-term base: dedicated area for industry, storage, breeding, food and boss team. The space for the large tame to turn around is more important than the decorative area.
Place a supply hut at the cave route entrance without blocking entrances / artifacts / spawns. Record base LAT/LON and transport routes in Ragnarok Notes.

sections.title: Suggested route · Ragnarok
items: Phase 1: survival, water/food, bed and replacement kit. Phase 2: stone base, metal tools, transportation and mining.
Phase 3: cave kit for each route, ocean tames, good weapons and warm gear. Phase 4: farm artifact/tribute, breed/imprint and boss team saddle.
Phase 5: survey the portal, fight Nunatak Gamma, then upgrade using actual loot. Advance only with enough materials, tames, and experience; a checklist records preparation, not a confirmed win.

sections.title: Single Player · platform for correct calculation
items: Record Difficulty, Maximum Difficulty, Use Singleplayer Settings, taming/breeding rates, resource respawn, and all mods before planning. These are input conditions; another server's stats are not the standard for your save.

Suggestion: keep settings stable, record after each change. The goal of a phase should be specific completion conditions: enough machines, enough equipment, enough tame and the exit route has been surveyed.
Creature levels and locations may change according to world and mod settings.

sections.title: Read maps & coordinates
items: LAT increases southward and LON eastward. Artifact marks the collection point; cave entrance marks the approach. Nearby points have a selection menu; use the Artifact / Cave entrance / Boss layers separately.
Cave entrance coordinates are community guidance and may vary with version or standing position. Area/reference points are not exact entrances. The map shows surface terrain, not cave floors.
